title: Download a DAW set on the public site with no server
description:
As a visitor to apricity.anth.us, I want the same download without a local server, so that anyone can take a score into their DAW.

```gherkin
Feature: Browser-side DAW set export on the cloud site
  Scenario: Guest downloads a public score
    Given I am not signed in and the score "march-blues" is public
    When I choose "Download for your DAW"
    Then the samples are fetched from the library bucket under the guest rules
    And the browser receives "March Blues Project.zip" with the set and every sample
    And no request is made to any export route on a server

  Scenario: A sample the visitor may not read
    Given the score uses a sample that guests cannot read
    When I choose "Download for your DAW"
    Then no zip is produced
    And the error names the sample and the track that uses it

  Scenario: Progress while samples download
    Given the score uses 12 samples
    When I choose "Download for your DAW"
    Then progress shows samples fetched out of 12 until the zip is ready
```
